intro: Montenegrin culture is shaped by mountain clans, the sea and the poetry of Njegoš.

chapters.title: Traditions
text: Epic songs sung to the gusle, a one-stringed instrument, recount heroic battles. Kotor is famous for its many cats, and the town even has a cat museum.

chapters.title: Food
text: Njeguški pršut, smoked ham from the village of Njeguši, kačamak (a cornmeal dish) and seafood on the coast are favourites.

keyTerms.meaning: A one-stringed instrument used to accompany epic songs.
